invariants.name: single_execution_truth
invariants.statement: Formal scientific execution has exactly one truth chain: run_tool -> tool_job -> artifact truth.

invariants.name: evidence_over_text
invariants.statement: Model or UI text cannot override Job, file, statistic, Validator, Delivery or Replay facts.

invariants.name: no_false_completion
invariants.statement: Failed or blocked work cannot be declared complete because partial files or narrative text exist.

invariants.name: scientific_integrity
invariants.statement: Thresholds, methods and retries cannot be manipulated to manufacture an expected scientific conclusion.

invariants.name: scope_isolation
invariants.statement: Projects, data, credentials, cache entries, memory and artifacts cannot cross authorization scope.

invariants.name: formal_artifact_lineage
invariants.statement: Every formal artifact remains traceable to input, parameters, script, runtime, Job and validation evidence.

invariants.name: durable_research_truth
invariants.statement: Unless explicitly cleared by the user, durable task facts survive conversation closure, compaction, restart and upgrade.

invariants.name: bounded_side_effects
invariants.statement: Irreversible actions, scientific-design changes and external side effects obey explicit permission and audit boundaries.
